visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark, spiky hair is seen lying lazily on a grey fabric sofa. He wears a red and white racing-style jersey with the number 10 on it. His expression is one of exhaustion and hunger as he looks toward the camera. The background is a plain white wall, and the lighting is bright and even, suggesting an indoor home environment. (2) The scene shifts to a doorway where another man, dressed in a striped shirt and a blue floral apron with a wig to appear as an older father, stands with his hands on his hips. He looks back with a reluctant expression before moving into a kitchen area. He opens a silver refrigerator filled with various food items. (3) A fast-paced editing sequence follows, showing the father character engaged in a comedic, high-speed cooking routine. He is seen chopping vegetables like white radishes and greens with exaggerated motions. He holds up cans of Bull Head Brand stock while dancing rhythmically. The kitchen features pale green wall tiles and modern appliances. (4) The final phase shows both characters sitting at a clean white table. In the center is a bubbling hot pot on a black induction cooker, surrounded by plates of raw meat, mushrooms, and vegetables. They use wooden chopsticks to eat and express deep satisfaction. Cans of the stock are prominently displayed on the table.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched, whiny male voice representing the hungry son, accompanied by a light, quirky synthesizer melody. The father responds with a gruff, lower-pitched tone. (2) A series of sharp 'whoosh' sound effects and high-impact drum hits mark the transition into a fast-paced montage. The music's tempo increases, featuring a driving electronic beat. (3) A professional narrator's voice with a clear, resonant tone takes over the pitch, describing the stock product. Crisp foley sounds of a metal can opening and soup pouring into a pot are layered over the energetic BGM. (4) The audio concludes with rhythmic chewing sounds and a satisfied vocal exclamation, ending on a final humorous line with the quirkier music returning at a lower volume.
